description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including compatible photo storage and managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, BLOB data types, and plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, and managed identity replaces embedded database credentials.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle BLOB columns used to store photo binary data to PostgreSQL bytea and convert any Oracle-specific SQL queries in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax. Update application.properties and application-docker.properties datasource configuration to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using managed identity instead of plaintext credentials.
